title: Chatterjee Residence
subtitle: Complete First-Floor Home Interior – Entrance, Living, Kitchen, Dining & Four Bedrooms
description: A 2,500 sq.ft. first-floor home interior in Gangarampur, from a carved-wood main door and a Buddha console in the living room to a glossy black kitchen, a fluted dining wall and four bedrooms, each with its own palette and a signature backlit feature wall.
body:
Designed for Asim Chatterjee in Indranarayanpur Colony, Gangarampur, this project covers the complete first floor of an independent house: around 2,500 sq.ft. of entrance, living, kitchen, dining and four bedrooms.

The home opens with a timber-wrapped entrance and a carved wood-finish main door, with a Panchmukhi Hanuman relief in a lit niche above. Inside, the living room is calm and light, organised around a Buddha console, while the kitchen and dining area pair glossy black units with a green marble table and a lit fluted wall.

Each of the four bedrooms has its own identity: copper leaf, green wave, walnut jaali and stone geometric. All four share floating beds with LED bases, backlit feature walls behind the bed and full-height built-in storage, so the home feels varied but consistent.
features.0.title: A Carved-Wood Arrival
features.0.text: The entrance lobby is wrapped in warm timber panelling, with vertical slats framing a sculpted wood-finish main door, a frosted glass sidelight and a long brass pull handle. Above the door, a lit niche holds a Panchmukhi Hanuman relief, and a floating square pendant lights the way in.
features.1.title: A Calm Living Room
features.1.text: The living room centres on a seated Buddha on a floating console, set against a soft patterned backdrop between walnut pilasters and lit by suspended timber spotlight batons. A marble-look TV wall with open display shelving faces an ivory sofa and a sculpted glass coffee table.
features.2.title: Kitchen & Dining
features.2.text: The U-shaped kitchen pairs glossy black base units with light upper cabinets and a stone backsplash. Next to it, the dining area has a green marble table with copper legs, a lit fluted wall, brass leaf art and a timber-slat ceiling.
features.3.title: The Study Bedroom
features.3.text: A copper leaf-pattern glass panel, framed by a curved LED cove, rises above a tufted grey headboard. A floating study desk with a lit bookshelf, a two-tone wardrobe with an open lit niche and a floating bed with an LED base complete the room.
features.4.title: The Green Wave Bedroom
features.4.text: Curved deep-green panels sweep across leaf-print wallpaper behind the bed, echoed by an S-curve backlit wardrobe panel and a slatted timber ceiling. A built-in study desk sits below a sculpted wavy shelf.
features.5.title: The Walnut & Jaali Bedroom
features.5.text: Twin backlit jaali panels frame the bed wall, and a full wall of bronze-tone panels between walnut battens wraps the room. Opposite, a full-height wardrobe in walnut and stone tones includes a flush door and a full-length mirror.
features.6.title: The Stone & Geometric Bedroom
features.6.text: A backlit patina panel with a geometric inlay sits above a quilted black headboard, next to a door clad in stone-finish panels with diagonal grooves. A two-tone stone wardrobe with a mirror finishes the darker, more dramatic palette of this room.
highlights.0.title: Complete First-Floor Interior
highlights.0.text: Entrance, living, kitchen, dining and four bedrooms designed as one home.
highlights.1.title: Four Distinct Bedrooms
highlights.1.text: Copper leaf, green wave, walnut jaali and stone geometric themes.
highlights.2.title: Backlit Feature Walls
highlights.2.text: Every bedroom has a lit signature panel behind the bed.
highlights.3.title: Built-In Study Desks
highlights.3.text: Floating desks with lit shelving are integrated into two bedrooms.
highlights.4.title: Carved Main Door & Prayer Niche
highlights.4.text: A sculpted wood-finish door with a lit Panchmukhi Hanuman niche above.
highlights.5.title: Layered Lighting
highlights.5.text: Cove lines, downlights, floating bed bases and backlit panels throughout.
